title: Wave 2 — Music as code; Comfy owns timbre
verifier_note: Built from wave-02 dispatch.md numbered findings that include url+finding. Omitted n lacking url: 3, 8, 9, 11, 12, 17, 19, 20, 21. Do not set verified=1 on new rows (ACCEPT_IDS wave-01 only).

lanes.title: Music is a seconds grid, not a prompt

findings.title: Standard MIDI Files 1.1
findings.finding: SMF times a sung line as integer ticks × microseconds-per-quarter, not BPM.
findings.implication: startSec is the integral of that map; a duration sentence in a prompt is not a clock.

findings.title: Intuitive Analysis of Song Structure
findings.finding: pretty_midi exists because MIDI ticks are unusable in Python; notes are pitch + start + end in seconds.
findings.implication: jam-sessions ScoreNote.startSec is already the lingua franca.

findings.title: music21: A Toolkit for Computer-Aided Musicology
findings.finding: music21 is the Python object graph of a score.
findings.implication: Python Streams, not SuperCollider or MIDI hex, are what an LLM emits correctly.

findings.title: librosa: Audio and Music Signal Analysis in Python
findings.finding: librosa analyzes audio; it does not specify a score.
findings.implication: DSP features recover a performance; they cannot author New Britain.

findings.title: ChatMusician
findings.finding: LLMs emit more valid music as Python/ABC than as MIDI-like tokens; free audio prompts fail the grid.
findings.implication: Python emits chords/beats/seconds; the model fills timbre.

findings.title: REMI
findings.finding: Without a beat-bar grid, sequence models drift; singing models consume phoneme × MIDI × duration.
findings.implication: sing in 35 seconds has nothing to scale.

lanes.title: One identity, retune F0 — never 14 people

findings.title: XiaoiceSing
findings.finding: XiaoiceSing residual F0 and DiffSinger MIDI-B condition one model on lyrics+MIDI.
findings.implication: score F0 is a residual around one singer, not a new TTS per note.

lanes.title: Timing is a contract; Comfy fills the window

findings.title: ByteDanceSeedAudio
findings.finding: ByteDance Seed Audio [start:end] stamps are an absolute output timeline and write leading silence.
findings.implication: jam-sessions startSec/durationSec emit those stamps; Python is the clock.

findings.title: ACE-Step
findings.finding: ACE-Step duration/BPM sizes a latent canvas; it is not note MIDI.
findings.implication: ACE-Step cannot honor New Britain onsets.

findings.title: Sinsy
findings.finding: Sinsy time-lag: vowel onset tracks the score; consonants anticipate.
findings.implication: stamps should target vowel windows, not letter onsets.

findings.title: IndexTTS2
findings.finding: Autoregressive TTS has no duration unless token count / MFA durations are inputs.
findings.implication: a prompt cannot be the metronome.

lanes.title: Comfy Cloud audio-to-audio (what actually takes a wav)

findings.title: ElevenLabsSpeechToSpeech
findings.finding: ElevenLabsSpeechToSpeech keeps words and emotion; knobs are speed/stability, not pitch_rate.
findings.implication: this is the Cloud node that transforms the Kokoro file without minting new text.
